nodes.label: Aishwaryam Oils Circular Brand Seal (ae monogram, 'QUALITY PRODUCTS')
nodes.author: Aishwaryam Oils
nodes.norm_label: aishwaryam oils circular brand seal (ae monogram, 'quality products')
nodes.rationale: Interlocked lowercase 'a'/'e' ligature treated as a heritage apothecary stamp. The circular seal is repeated on every SKU so the six-bottle range reads as one family even when thumbnails are cropped.

nodes.label: Back-Panel Ingredient & Nutrition Disclosure
nodes.author: Aishwaryam Oils
nodes.rationale: Back of the shrink label carries single-ingredient declaration ('Undefined Sweet Coconut'), nutritional table, FSSAI licence number, batch/lot and best-before fields. Regulatory completeness sits on the reverse so the front stays a single-word proposition.

nodes.label: "100% Natural, Cold Pressed Coconut Oil" Claim
nodes.author: Aishwaryam Oils
nodes.norm_label: "100% natural, cold pressed coconut oil" claim
nodes.rationale: Front-of-seal qualifier used as the searchable/shoppable attribute; 'cold pressed' is the term consumers query, while 'wood crushed' is the producer's vocabulary — the label carries both so the bottle satisfies either search.

nodes.label: 1 Litre Bottle Format (clear PET, green screw cap)
nodes.author: Aishwaryam Oils
nodes.norm_label: 1 litre bottle format (clear pet, green screw cap)
nodes.rationale: Clear vessel makes the pale, near-crystalline oil itself the visual proof of purity; the uniform 1 L size across the range keeps pricing comparisons to a single axis and lets one card grid hold every SKU.

nodes.label: "Wood Crushed" Processing Claim
nodes.author: Aishwaryam Oils
nodes.rationale: The label leads with process ('WOOD CRUSHED') above the product name, positioning traditional slow mechanical pressing as the differentiator rather than the seed itself; the storefront's editorial section mirrors this same ordering.

nodes.label: Coconut Oil Product Photograph (Aishwaryam Oils)
nodes.author: Aishwaryam Oils
nodes.rationale: Studio cut-out on pure white with the brand seal offset to the top-right and a floral line-art motif bottom-left. This is catalogue/marketplace-style product photography: no lifestyle context, bottle fully legible, background safe for compositing into any card or carousel tile on the storefront.

nodes.label: asal-cart-v1 localStorage Cart
nodes.rationale: Versioned localStorage key stores only product IDs and quantities so the bag survives refresh and syncs across tabs without persisting customer data. Malformed data and unavailable storage are handled, and the per-product UI limit of 99 is an interface bound, not an inventory claim.

nodes.label: Razorpay Readiness Checklist
nodes.rationale: Before enabling Razorpay: replace the attributed reference catalogue; configure real delivery eligibility, shipping and tax (currently unconfigured, not free); provision durable order storage and policies; revalidate stock and recompute payable amount server-side; create pending orders idempotently linked to the provider order ID with server-only secrets; verify signatures and webhooks with deduplication; add rate limiting and failure/retry/replay tests.

nodes.label: 16 KiB Body Limit and no-store Responses
nodes.norm_label: 16 kib body limit and no-store responses
nodes.rationale: JSON requests are capped at 16 KiB and every endpoint response sets Cache-Control: no-store, bounding abuse and preventing caching of contact/pricing data.

nodes.label: Checkout Review Invalidation
nodes.rationale: A checkout review becomes invalid whenever the bag changes, including changes made from another tab, so a stale review can never be submitted as the basis of an order.

nodes.label: review_ready Response Contract
nodes.rationale: The server returns review_ready rather than an order so the UI never fabricates an order ID, clears the bag or claims success before payment exists; duplicate, unknown, empty and invalid lines are rejected.

nodes.label: Forest Green and Powder Blue Palette
nodes.norm_label: forest green and powder blue palette
nodes.rationale: Forest #173f34 anchors the brand, mid-green #48745b supports process sections, powder blue #e8f2f8 with blue-ink #365e78 supplies quiet accents, and white surfaces keep the catalogue retail-clean.

nodes.label: Fraunces and DM Sans Typography
nodes.rationale: Locally hosted Fraunces editorial display paired with DM Sans UI, approximately 58px desktop / 43px mobile hero, following the editorial-serif direction observed in Mooala.

nodes.label: Vercel Commerce Discovery (Shopify)
nodes.rationale: Commerce discovery via Vercel 65.7.0 on 29 October 2026 returned Shopify; no store was provisioned because the requested flow stops before the planned Razorpay integration.

nodes.label: Razorpay boundary
nodes.rationale: Payment integration is deliberately not implemented: the last screen states that no order is placed and payment is unavailable, and the app does not fabricate an order ID, clear the bag or claim success. src/lib/checkout.ts holds the reusable server validation/calculation function and src/app/api/checkout/route.ts is the pre-payment review endpoint.

nodes.label: Asal — design direction
nodes.rationale: A white, forest-green and powder-blue wood-pressed oil collection built from a greenfield brief; the Asal name is taken from the workspace name pending user confirmation.

nodes.label: Asal Organics
nodes.rationale: Positioned as a Next.js App Router storefront with an oil catalogue, product discovery, saved favourites, a persistent browser cart and pre-payment checkout review; verification is gated on npm test, typecheck and build.

nodes.label: Before launch
nodes.rationale: The storefront remains a reference-catalogue preview: imagery and indicative prices are attributed to Aishwaryam Oils and must be replaced with licensed merchant-owned content. Razorpay is deferred, and checkout intentionally stops at review rather than claiming an order was placed, because there is still no payment collection, order persistence, inventory reservation, shipping or tax configuration.

nodes.label: This is NOT the Next.js You Know (agent rule)
nodes.norm_label: this is not the next.js you know (agent rule)
nodes.rationale: The installed Next.js version has breaking changes relative to model training data, so agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing code and heed deprecation notices. The block is re-generated by `next dev` (generate-agent-files.js), so deleting it from a diff only re-creates the uncommitted change; committing it keeps the tree clean.

nodes.label: Ephemeral Contact and Address Handling
nodes.rationale: Address and contact data live only in React memory for navigation within the visit, are never written to localStorage, server storage or application logs, and are cleared on refresh to limit privacy exposure.

nodes.label: Integer INR Paise Pricing
nodes.rationale: Prices are recalculated server-side in integer paise from the catalogue and client-supplied prices are ignored, making the review tamper-resistant against browser totals.

nodes.label: Reference Catalogue Attribution Limitation
nodes.rationale: Product names, prices and photos are public reference material attributed visibly to Aishwaryam Oils; they assert nothing about Asal's own inventory, certification, reviews or business claims and must be replaced with licensed merchant-owned assets before production publication.

nodes.label: noindex Preview Pages
nodes.rationale: Preview pages deliberately use noindex so unlicensed reference products and imagery are not indexed as Asal inventory before launch.

nodes.label: Two-Band Bottle Label with Vertical Product Name
nodes.norm_label: two-band bottle label with vertical product name
nodes.rationale: Label is split into a pale cream upper band (brand mark, subtitle) and a warmer amber/ochre lower band (vertical uppercase 'ALMOND OIL'). The amber band visually echoes the golden oil and ground almonds while the vertical lettering leaves high-contrast negative space, keeping a tall narrow 250ml bottle legible at catalogue/thumbnail size. Black screw cap frames the top with a dark anchor point against an otherwise transparent, light-filled bottle.

nodes.label: Reference Product Catalogue (products.ts)
nodes.rationale: Holds id/name/size/price/originalPrice/image/category/note/description/source for each of the six oils. Prices and copy are reference data scraped from aishwaryamoils.com, not live commerce values — the FAQ states Razorpay payments and delivery/tax settings are not enabled yet.

nodes.label: AE Monogram Brand Mark
nodes.rationale: Interlocking 'ae' monogram in amber repeats in three places (bottle label, right-hand roundel, fine print) to build brand recall; the circular 'AISHWARYAM OILS - QUALITY PRODUCTS' seal mimics a certification stamp to signal trust/authenticity.

nodes.label: Aishwaryam Oils (Brand)
nodes.rationale: Positioned as a small-batch, traditional South Indian oil mill ('Quality Products' tagline, wood cold pressed claim) rather than a mass-market edible-oil label.

nodes.label: Botanical Line-Art Flourish (Composited Overlay)
nodes.rationale: Thin black hand-drawn vine/leaf motif in the lower-left corner is a decorative brand flourish layered onto the cut-out photo, reinforcing the natural/traditional-artisanal positioning without adding packaging text.

nodes.label: aishwaryamoils.com
nodes.rationale: The URL is printed on the label, so the physical pack funnels customers to the same web storefront whose product images this file belongs to.

nodes.label: Nutrition Information Panel (per 100 g)
nodes.rationale: FSSAI-style mandatory declarations (energy, protein, carbohydrate, fat, saturated/trans fat, cholesterol, sodium), veg mark, net quantity, batch no., mfg/packing/expiry dates and customer-care contacts are present because Indian packaged-food labelling regulation requires them; they also double as a credibility cue on the product page.

nodes.label: Wood Cold Pressed Groundnut Oil
nodes.rationale: 'Wood crushed' / cold-press wording is the primary differentiator on pack: low-temperature wooden ghani extraction is marketed as retaining nutrients and flavour versus refined solvent-extracted oil. The clear bottle plus deep amber oil colour is used as visual proof of unrefined, unfiltered product.

nodes.label: Groundnut Oil Bottle Product Photograph
nodes.rationale: Square, centered, isolated-on-white catalog shot of a single 750 ml clear PET bottle, sized for e-commerce product cards/grids where uniform framing and pure white background allow consistent thumbnails and easy compositing.

nodes.label: Isolated White-Background Product Staging
nodes.rationale: Design decision: no props, no set, no human hand — the bottle is cut out on pure white with only a soft ground shadow so the asset works in any card aspect ratio and matches sibling product images in the same public/images/products directory.
